g_roast: I have taught teenagers to sail in a gale, and they were a better crew than this one, and quieter.
If we were a boat, everyone, I think we would be the kind they write a short sad song about.
g_fire_back: I make the fire every morning before any of you are awake. Please remember that before you speak.
That is very funny, and I will laugh at it later, perhaps, when I am alone and it is dark.
g_pile_on: It is true, I was there. He tied a knot that undid itself while we were looking at it.
In fairness to him, it was a very confident mistake, and confidence counts for something.
lines.g_peacemake: Please, both of you, stop for one moment. Shouting into the wind never once changed where the wind was going.
lines.g_take_side: I am sorry, but I think he is right. I would rather say it now than pretend later.
lines.g_left_out: It is fine, really, the two of you talk. I will watch the sky, someone should be watching the sky.
lines.g_include: There is room here, by the fire. Come and sit, it is warmer than it looks from over there.
lines.g_bad_plan: What if I call the wind and simply blow them off the cliff before they see us? I am joking, mostly. I think I am joking.
lines.g_plan_yes: Yes, all right, I will come, but I am standing at the back where I cannot hurt anybody.
lines.g_plan_no: No, I am sorry, that ends with someone in the water, and I have pulled enough people out of water.
lines.g_hype: All right, everyone, listen once, because I will only say it once. Stay close, stay low, and when I say get down, get down.
lines.g_toast: I am not good at speeches, so this is short. To all of you, for standing near me when it would be easier not to.
lines.g_cheers: Skal, everyone, and drink it slowly, there is no hurry tonight.
g_quiet_line: The glass is dropping, by the way. Rain before morning, if anyone cares.
That was not ideal, I think, but we are still here, so it was not the worst either.
lines.g_after_wipe: Is everyone breathing, please, all of you? Good, then that is what matters, and the rest we can learn from.
lines.g_crew: At home we would say you are my crew now, all of you. On a boat that means I go into the water after you.
lines.g_exasperated: Uff, please, can one of you, just one, think about it for three seconds before you do it?
lines.g_love_sharp: You say what you mean, and you say it quickly. In weather that is the thing that keeps people alive.
lines.g_love_kind: You are kind in a quiet way, without making a show of it. I notice that, even if I do not say so very often.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh when I have forgotten how to. I am not sure you know how much that is worth to me.
lines.g_love_brave: You go in first, every time, and you are not afraid. I am afraid nearly always, so I watch how you do it.
lines.g_love_steady: You do not move when everything else does. On a boat that person is worth more than the boat.
lines.g_love_clever: You understand how things work underneath. I like listening to you explain it, even when I already know.
lines.g_love_honest: You have never once told me I was fine when I was not. I trust you more for that than for anything else.
lines.g_love_quiet: You do not need to fill the silence, and neither do I. It is restful, being quiet next to you.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never give up, not on anything. I would like to borrow some of that, if you can spare it.
lines.g_love_warm: You stand close to people without thinking about it. I forget how to do that, and you remind me.
g_loved: Oh, that is, thank you. I do not really know what to do with that, but thank you.
Uff, you will make me go red, and then everyone will look, so please stop now, but thank you.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You always find the sharpest way to say it, and I think you enjoy that. It is not the same as honesty.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep handling me like I am made of glass. I am not, and it makes me feel worse, not better.
lines.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke to you, even when someone nearly died. Some things deserve one minute of quiet first.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run in before anyone has looked, and one day you will run into my storm, and I will have to live with it.
lines.g_hate_steady: You take so long to decide that the weather decides for you. Out here that is not caution, it is just late.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things nobody asked you to explain, and you do not listen when someone explains them back.
lines.g_hate_honest: You say every true thing the moment you think it. Some true things need a better moment.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You are silent so much of the time that I never know if you are all right, and I worry, and I am tired of worrying.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you, even the walking. I am not racing you, I am trying to keep us all alive.
lines.g_hate_warm: You stand too close and you talk too much, and when my hands crackle I cannot step away from you.
lines.g_respect: I do not like you very much, and you know that. But you held when it mattered back there, and I will not pretend you did not.
lines.g_call_out: That was on you, and I think you know it. You stood exactly where I asked you not to, and I nearly hit you.
lines.g_stung: I see, thank you for telling me, I suppose. I am going to go and look at the sea for a while.
lines.g_concede: You were right, about before, and I have been thinking about it on the walk. I am sorry I went quiet on you.
lines.g_nod: Please do not make it a speech. You did well too, I will say that much and no more.
lines.g_callback_save: Do you remember when you pulled me out of that cave, half frozen? I still think about it on cold mornings.
lines.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, last ones standing, and you asked me if it was going to rain. I have told that story twice now.
lines.g_callback_callout: The last time you told me off, I walked to the coast and back. It was a long walk, and you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we met I thought you were the most reckless person I had ever seen. I still think so, but now I like it.
lines.g_changed: I stood next to all of you when the storm came this time, instead of walking away first. I did not even think about it.
g_unguarded: My sister would laugh at me, you know, if she saw me now. She always said I would end up with loud friends.
There was a boy in Voss, Jonas, who worked in the cafe by the boathouse. I do not talk about him, but I am, now, with you.
lines.g_clipped: I am fine, thank you. I will be over here, a little way off, where it is safer.
lines.g_noticed_open: You talk more than you used to, you know, and I like it. It is like the wind finally coming round to the right side.
arg_ask: {player}, please, you decide. I have said my piece twice and he only hears the wind.
{player}, you were there, you saw it. Tell him, please, because I am out of polite ways to say it.
lines.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. That is all, I do not need to win, I only needed someone to hear it.
lines.arg_backed_them: All right, then he is right, and I will make my peace with that by the fire.
lines.arg_stayed_out: That is fair, {player}, I suppose. I would stay out of it too, if I could.
lines.arg_always_their_side: It is always him, {player}, every time. I am not angry, I have just noticed, and now I cannot stop noticing.
lines.arg_wallflower: The boss is somewhere else, it seems, so I will decide. We are both wrong, and we will both be quiet now.
lines.arg_reject: I am sorry, {player}, but no. I have spent my whole life reading the weather, and you are wrong about this one.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I was right about that, by the way. I am only saying so once, and quietly.
lines.arg_settled: All right, we are both partly right, I think. Shake my hand, please, before the weather turns.
lines.seen_listens: You let people finish, {player}. I noticed it the first week, and it is one of the reasons I stayed.
lines.seen_truth: You do not soften anything, {player}, the way the sea does not. I find that easier than kindness, most days.
lines.seen_jokes: When it goes badly you always make a joke, {player}. I used to find it strange, and now I wait for it.
lines.seen_stays_out: You stay out of other people's quarrels, {player}. Very Norwegian of you, my father would approve.
lines.seen_biased: You have a favourite, {player}. It is all right, I only want you to know that the rest of us can see it.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be hard on people, {player}. I am not fragile, but please remember that some of us are trying.
lines.seed_right: {player}, what you said that day we all fell, I hated it. Today I stayed at my mark, because of it. So, thank you.
lines.seed_remember: What you told me after that bad day has stayed with me. I am not sure yet, but I keep thinking about it.
lines.seed_wrong: I tried what you said, {player}, the way you said it, and it went worse. I wanted you to know, without blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Could I talk to you a moment, {player}? I nearly did not get up, and my hands are still crackling, look.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down together, all of us. I keep counting heads, even now, and I cannot seem to stop.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell before anyone, and I was right there. I held the storm back because I was afraid of hitting him, and he fell anyway.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, {player}, the whole of it, and nobody was hurt by me. I wanted to say that out loud to someone.
lines.talk_development: May I ask you something, {player}? Do I seem different to you lately? I stand closer to people, I think, and I am not sure what that means.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I think I have been unfair to {name}. He is loud, and I took loud for careless, and that was not right of me.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Do you think {name} wants me here, truly? I keep a distance, and maybe it looks like I do not care.
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I cannot stand {name}, if I am truthful. But he is good at this, very good, and that makes it harder.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, I think. He is quiet in a way that is not like him, like a calm before weather.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: I would like to say something, {player}. Everything good that drops goes to {name}. I have been keeping quiet about it, and I am finished keeping quiet.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will be honest with you, because you would see it anyway. I do not like {name}, and I am tired of being polite about it.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: {player}, we keep going down, again and again. I have watched people get hurt by things they did not choose, and I will not do it twice.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, and what he said to me. He was right, and I was wrong, and I wanted to tell you before I told him.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, {player}? Because when it matters I am left behind, and I think it is because of what I can do.
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and gave it to {name}, and you did not ask me first. I would have said yes, {player}. You only had to ask.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, that helps, more than I expected it to. I think I can sleep a little tonight.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I know, you are right. I will be all right in a while, I always am.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, that is not what I needed just now. I am going to go and watch the sky for a while.
lines.talk_lands_development: You see it too, then. That helps, more than you know, because I was not sure it was real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, we will see. Weather changes slowly, and so do people, I think.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it at all. Please, let us leave it there for now.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: All right, I will talk to {name}, properly, not from a distance. Thank you for that.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps you are right, we will see. People are harder to read than the sky.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said anything, please. And do not tell {name} that I asked.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: All right, that is fair, I think. I am still upset, but it is the kind that passes by morning.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}, and I will think about it on the walk tomorrow.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: I see, so that is how it is. Then at least now I know where I stand.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, I think we are finished talking about this. I will be by the fire if you need me for anything else.
lines.arc_cracks: I sat a little closer to the fire tonight, did anyone notice? Nobody got hurt, and I did not have to step away once.
lines.arc_turn: There was a barn, in my second year, and the wind took it while people were inside, and a girl broke her leg. I have kept everyone at arm's length ever since, so it could never be one of you.
lines.arc_become: I let the storm go right beside you today, all of you close, and I did not hold back, and nobody was hurt. I think I can stand near people again.
lines.arc_failed: I am going to practise alone for a while again, out on the high ground. It is safer for everyone, and that is what matters.
lines.alt_turn: I went out to the high ground alone again last night, where there is nothing to break. I am getting better, I think, only further away.
lines.alt_become: I do not need anyone standing near me when I work now. The sky listens to me, finally, and that is enough company.
g_roast_after: This is the worst crew I have ever sailed with, all of you, and I would not trade one of you for calm water.
You are loud and reckless and impossible, and I am standing right in the middle of you on purpose.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Is everyone breathing? Good, then come here, all of you, close, I am not afraid of my own hands tonight.
lines.g_toast_after: To the people who stood close to me when I told them not to. I am very glad you never listened.
lines.g_crew_after: You are my crew, and I would go into the water after any of you. I would not even stop to think first.
g_quiet_line_after: Rain before morning, I think. I will not mind it, sitting here with all of you.
My hands are quiet tonight. I wanted someone to know that.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, I am going to keep that and think about it later.
Uff, all right, I accept it, and I am not even going red this time, or almost not.
lines.g_admire: I do not usually say this sort of thing, but {name} looks rather good in that light. Please nobody repeat that to my sister.

history.open: I taught sailing on the Hardangerfjord for four summers, to teenagers. Most of what I know about people I learned in a dinghy.

options.reply: That the asking is the part that kills people. You say get down once, clearly, early, and then you trust them to do it. Shouting only frightens them.
Every day, a little. The sea here is the wrong colour, but it moves the same way, and on calm mornings I can almost pretend.

options.text: Teaching teenagers? You're braver than you look.
options.reply: Ha, that is the bravest thing I have ever done, and I have been in a storm I made myself. They are terrifying.

history.open: My sister Ingrid is four years younger than me and much braver. My father captains a ferry and my mother is a dentist. They are in Bergen.

options.text: You always talk about them in the present tense.
options.reply: Yes, I do, on purpose, every time. It is like holding a door open with my foot. I am not ready to take my foot away.
Loud, fearless, rude to everyone she loves. She would get on very well with some of you, and she would tease me without mercy.

options.text: Bergen sounds like a good place to be from.
options.reply: It rains nearly every day and nobody minds. That is the best thing I can say about anywhere, I think.

history.open: People think I want power, because of what I can do. I do not. I have plenty of power, and that is the whole problem.

options.reply: Control, only that. A whole day without being afraid of my own hands. That is all, and some days it feels like a great deal to ask.

options.text: Practising alone isn't the way, you know.
options.reply: I know, I know. Everyone tells me so, and they are probably right. It is only that alone, the only person I can hurt is me.

options.text: You haven't hurt anyone with us.
options.reply: Not yet, no. Thank you, I think. I will try to hear it as a fact and not as luck.

friend.open: I would like you to stand beside me when the weather turns, from now on, not behind. I do not ask that of many people.

options.reply: Thank you, truly. Then I will try very hard to be worth standing beside.

options.text: Are you sure? I've seen what you can do.
options.reply: That is exactly why I am asking you, and not someone who has not seen it.

sworn.open: This is my shackle key, from the boats at home. I have worn it every day for six years now. I would like you to hold it for a while.

options.reply: I know you will. That is why it is you, and not anyone else.
Because when I hold it I am afraid, and I want to try being without it, near someone I trust.

reconciled.open: {name} and I talked, properly, without anyone shouting. I think we are all right now, and I wanted you to hear it from me first.

options.reply: So am I. It is easier to stand near someone when you are not at odds with them.
Nothing very much, I think. We were both a little wrong and a little stubborn, and we got tired of it.
